comment: Thirty-seven of the 77 parameters have no widget and cannot be clicked: the run state, the current mode, the sixteen pattern selectors, the selected channel, the two copy registers and the sixteen channel mutes (src/Y.cpp:198-215). They are parameters so that Rack saves them, and they are set from the buttons that are on the panel. The run button's lamp is driven from the beat rather than from the run state (line 502), which is why its line says so. The position input is read with getVoltage rather than per channel, and every output is forced to one channel (lines 158-163 and 393). The CV and gate inputs let a MIDI keyboard work the panel: a gate edge reads the CV as a note number and looks the action up in a 128 entry table (lines 102-116 and 405-417), in which the black keys reach the function and mode buttons and the white keys the step buttons. The extra details the maker wrote are in Y.md in the repository. The panel prints OUTPUT GATES, PAT, SEQ, MUTE, NOW, CV, GATE, RST, RUN, G.LEN, CPY, PST, 3, JAZZ, 4, TEMPO, RST, RUN and NOTES & TRIPLES; the step buttons themselves carry no lettering, and neither does the position input.
